cd /Volumes/Externalwork/archon-cli/archon-cli && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
project=pathlib.Path('/Volumes/Externalwork/archon-cli/project-1')
registry_path=project/'.archon/trading-lab/data/registry.json'
report_path=project/'.archon/trading-lab/data/registry-migration-report.json'
registry=json.loads(registry_path.read_text())
required=['dataset_path','manifest_path','metadata_path','normalized_path','provider_notes_path','raw_path','raw_request_path','raw_response_path','redacted_headers_path','validation_path']
healthy=[]
for key, record in registry['datasets'].items():
    if record.get('status') == 'Healthy':
        missing_flags=[f for f in ['native_interval','production_eligible'] if record.get(f) is not True]
        missing_paths=[field for field in required if not record.get(field) or not (project/record[field]).exists()]
        if missing_flags or missing_paths:
            raise SystemExit(f'{key} incomplete flags={missing_flags} paths={missing_paths}')
        healthy.append(key)
report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
if registry.get('schema_version') != 'archon-trading-data-registry-v2':
    raise SystemExit(f'bad registry schema {registry.get("schema_version")}')
if report.get('schema_version') != 'archon-trading-data-registry-v2' or report.get('failed') not in (0, None):
    raise SystemExit(f'bad migration report schema={report.get("schema_version")} failed={report.get("failed")}')
print(f'registry_exists={registry_path.exists()} report_exists={report_path.exists()} schema={registry.get("schema_version")} healthy_checked={len(healthy)} datasets={len(registry["datasets"])} migration_schema={report.get("schema_version")} migrated={report.get("migrated")} skipped={report.get("skipped")} failed={report.get("failed")}')
